statement: check_packaged_library on a copy of the exported bundle under build/ (not a symlinked path), one change at a time; the untouched copy must be accepted and every change must be refused. The report removal case shows what the check does when the original verification report is absent.

cases.case: one byte flipped in the wcag rendition
cases.message: A packaged artifact differs from the verified export.

cases.case: one byte flipped in the wcag signed map
cases.message: A packaged artifact differs from the verified export.

cases.case: broadcast rendition replaced by the extra-cautious one
cases.message: A packaged artifact differs from the verified export.

cases.case: manifest sha edited for the wcag map
cases.message: The packaged manifest bytes differ from the catalog.

cases.case: hidden_ms edited inside the wcag map text (signature no longer matches)
cases.message: A packaged artifact differs from the verified export.

note: The plain check treats the original verification report as an attachment and accepts a bundle without it, as its documentation says; the strict gate scripts/release.sh uses (require_reports) refuses it. Both behaviours are recorded above.
